encoding.resizeFilter: Lanczos for responsive variants; original-size main images not resized
encoding.colorHandling: Original sRGB IEC61966-2.1 ICC profile retained in every WebP; no color filters or color-space conversion
encoding.qualityMode: Lossy WebP re-encoding, not pixel-lossless; responsive variants additionally downsample the source at unchanged aspect ratio.

images.usage: 企业介绍：新商业范式下游封面
images.qualitySelection: q95 selected after source/q92/q95 native-pixel visual comparison, retaining more original grain and fine texture; all variants use q95 as well. No lossless candidate is needed because the user requested visual quality and compression rather than identical pixels.
images.visualCheck: Original and encoded overall appearance plus native-pixel signage, fern leaves, woven chair, mural detail or product lettering/bottle label were compared as applicable. q95 retains detail without obvious visible blocking in inspected crops; lossy differences remain at pixel level.
images.composition: No crop, rotation, retouching, generation or color filter; original aspect ratio maintained.

verification.dimensionAndIccChecks: Every output decoded; actual dimensions and retained ICC bytes asserted.
verification.psnrMethod: Full-image RGB PSNR against source decoded pixels at matching resolution; responsive references resized once with Lanczos.
verification.ssimMethod: Main-image native-pixel crops recorded in QA crop-regions.json; BT.601 luminance, 11x11 Gaussian window sigma1.5, valid interior, K1=0.01/K2=0.03/L=255. Crop SSIM is not a full-image score.
verification.visualScope: Local image and crop inspection only; no browser or device verification.

deliveryAdvice: Use the 1920-wide variant for ordinary image src and responsive srcset with accurate sizes. Use 960 for narrow displays, 3840 for larger/high-DPR displays, and original-width main only when the displayed image density requires it. Never preload all originals or set the 12 MB shop originals as the default src.
